source: synthetic. The same screen as blocked.txt, with an ordinary pane title
        instead of one carrying "Action Required" — which is what a terminal
        that does not relay Codex's OSC 0 title shows, and what tmux shows for
        a pane whose title has not been rewritten this turn.
why: upstream's two screen blockers are both defined relative to the Codex
     prompt marker, and this screen puts the marker on the option line, so
     `after_last_prompt_marker` and `whole_recent_without_current_prompt_marker`
     are both empty and neither can fire. Without the title, upstream alone
     reads an unanswered approval prompt as idle. See
     manifests/sidecar/codex.toml (`sidecar.approval_blocker`).
